title: Left-coefficient action laws from normalized open restriction
statement:
Use monoidal categories [def-sfb-monoidal-category] with associator $\alpha:(U\otimes V)\otimes W\to U\otimes(V\otimes W)$ and left unitor $\lambda$. A strong monoidal functor has the structure of [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor]; write $\delta^H_{U,V}:H(U\otimes V)\xrightarrow{\sim}HU\otimes HV$ and $e_H:H\mathbf1\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf1$ for its inverse structure maps. Set $h^H_N=\lambda_N\circ(e_H\otimes1_N)$ and $a^H_{B,B',N}=\alpha_{HB,HB',N}\circ(\delta^H_{B,B'}\otimes1_N)$. Composition is right to left.
A symmetry $\beta_{U,V}:U\otimes V\xrightarrow{\sim}V\otimes U$ means natural involutive tensor swaps satisfying the hexagon identities with $\alpha$; a symmetric strong monoidal functor preserves these swaps under $\delta$.
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be symmetric monoidal categories, $Q:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ a symmetric strong monoidal functor, and $J:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ a fully faithful left adjoint to $Q$. Here fully faithful means that $J$ induces bijections on all Hom sets. Let $u:1_{\mathcal D}\xrightarrow{\sim}QJ$ be the adjunction unit, using the convention of [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. Suppose given natural isomorphisms $\gamma_{M,C}:JM\otimes C\xrightarrow{\sim}J(M\otimes QC)$ for all $M\in\mathcal D$, $C\in\mathcal C$, with the specified restriction normalization
$$u_{M\otimes QC}^{-1}\circ Q(\gamma_{M,C})=(u_M^{-1}\otimes1_{QC})\circ\delta^Q_{JM,C}.$$
Define $v_{C,M}=J(\beta_{M,QC})\circ\gamma_{M,C}\circ\beta_{C,JM}:C\otimes JM\xrightarrow{\sim}J(QC\otimes M)$. Then $v$ is natural, has the left-coefficient normalization
$$u_{QC\otimes M}^{-1}\circ Q(v_{C,M})=(1_{QC}\otimes u_M^{-1})\circ\delta^Q_{C,JM},$$
and satisfies, for every $C,C'\in\mathcal C$, $M\in\mathcal D$,
$$J(h^Q_M)\circ v_{\mathbf1,M}=\lambda_{JM},$$
$$J(a^Q_{C,C',M})\circ v_{C\otimes C',M}=v_{C,QC'\otimes M}\circ(1_C\otimes v_{C',M})\circ\alpha_{C,C',JM}.$$
These are equalities in $\mathcal C$ for the specified $\gamma$, not assertions that arbitrary isomorphisms with these sources and targets satisfy the laws.

source.place: Agent-formulated categorical lemma for Stacks Tag 0GL1 (sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor) and Tag 0E8I (sites-modules.tex, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor): deriving the two left-coefficient constraints from the normalized restriction. Parent old proof Steps 2 (open part) and 5.

proof.text:
Since $J$ is a fully faithful left adjoint, its unit $u$ is a natural isomorphism [lem-sp-adjunction-unit-fully-faithful-left]; this is the invertibility used in writing $u:1_{\mathcal D}\xrightarrow{\sim}QJ$. Write $r_N=u_N^{-1}$, $\delta=\delta^Q$ and $e=e_Q$. Naturality of the unit gives $r_{N'}\circ QJ(t)=t\circ r_N$ for every $t:N\to N'$. Each factor defining $v$ is an isomorphism, so $v$ is an isomorphism. For $c:C\to D$ and $m:M\to N$, naturality of the two symmetries and of $\gamma$ gives, by composing their naturality squares,
$$J(Qc\otimes m)\circ v_{C,M}=v_{D,N}\circ(c\otimes Jm).$$
This proves naturality of the specified composite, without changing its normalization.

source.place: Tag 0037, definition-adjoint and the following unit paragraph; elementary composition of the naturality squares in the hypotheses.

proof.text:
Use the preceding naturality identity for $r$ with $t=\beta_{M,QC}$. The given normalization of $\gamma$, preservation of symmetry by $Q$, and naturality of symmetry give the explicit calculation
$$\begin{aligned}
r_{QC\otimes M}\circ Q(v_{C,M})
&=\beta_{M,QC}\circ r_{M\otimes QC}\circ Q(\gamma_{M,C})\circ Q(\beta_{C,JM})\\
&=\beta_{M,QC}\circ(r_M\otimes1_{QC})\circ\delta_{JM,C}\circ Q(\beta_{C,JM})\\
&=\beta_{M,QC}\circ(r_M\otimes1_{QC})\circ\beta_{QC,QJM}\circ\delta_{C,JM}\\
&=(1_{QC}\otimes r_M)\circ\delta_{C,JM}.
\end{aligned}$$
The last equality uses $\beta_{M,QC}\circ\beta_{QC,M}=1$ after moving $r_M$ through the swap. Denote this normalized map by $b_{C,M}$.

source.place: Tags 0037 and 0FFL (definition-functor-monoidal-categories); agent calculation from the given symmetry and gamma normalization.

proof.text: Here is the equality test needed below, with its entire argument. For $f,g:JA\to Z$, equality $Qf=Qg$ implies $Qf\circ u_A=Qg\circ u_A$, hence $f=g$ by injectivity of the adjunction bijection $\Psi(f)=Qf\circ u_A$. If the common source $W$ is merely isomorphic to $JA$, precompose both maps with that isomorphism and use this same argument, then cancel it. In particular it applies to maps from $\mathbf1\otimes JM$ and from $(C\otimes C')\otimes JM$: the inverse of $v_{\mathbf1,M}$ or of $v_{C\otimes C',M}$ is the required isomorphism $JA\to W$. Thus equality of their $Q$-images suffices. When their common target is $JN$, one may also postcompose those images with the invertible $r_N$.

source.place: Tag 0037, definition-adjoint and the formula for the Hom bijection in the paragraph following it; elementary injectivity and isomorphism cancellation.

proof.text:
For the unit law, the normalization from Step 2 and naturality of $r$ give
$$\begin{aligned}
r_M\circ Q\bigl(J(h^Q_M)\circ v_{\mathbf1,M}\bigr)
&=h^Q_M\circ(1_{Q\mathbf1}\otimes r_M)\circ\delta_{\mathbf1,JM}\\
&=r_M\circ\lambda_{QJM}\circ(e\otimes1_{QJM})\circ\delta_{\mathbf1,JM}\\
&=r_M\circ Q(\lambda_{JM}).
\end{aligned}$$
The second line is naturality of $\lambda$. The last line is exactly the inverse form of the strong monoidal left-unit axiom, obtained by cancelling its invertible structure maps. Apply Step 3 to the common source $\mathbf1\otimes JM$ and cancel $r_M$ to obtain the claimed equality in $\mathcal C$.

source.place: Tags 0FFK and 0FFL, definition-monoidal-category and definition-functor-monoidal-categories; Tag 0037 for unit naturality and the equality test.

proof.text:
Fix $C,C',M$ and put $T=QC\otimes(QC'\otimes M)$. For the left side $L=J(a^Q_{C,C',M})\circ v_{C\otimes C',M}$ of the associativity law, naturality of $r$ and Step 2 give
$$\begin{aligned}
r_T\circ Q(L)
&=a^Q_{C,C',M}\circ(1_{Q(C\otimes C')}\otimes r_M)\circ\delta_{C\otimes C',JM}\\
&=\alpha_{QC,QC',M}\circ(\delta_{C,C'}\otimes r_M)\circ\delta_{C\otimes C',JM}.
\end{aligned}$$
The second line expands the specified $a^Q$ and uses preservation of composition by the tensor bifunctor. Call this last expression $E$.

source.place: Tags 0037, 0FFK and 0FFL; elementary expansion of the specified action associator and restriction normalization.

proof.text:
Let $R=v_{C,QC'\otimes M}\circ(1_C\otimes v_{C',M})\circ\alpha_{C,C',JM}$. Applying Step 2 to its first factor and then naturality of $\delta$ to its second factor yields
$$\begin{aligned}
r_T\circ Q(R)
&=(1_{QC}\otimes r_{QC'\otimes M})\circ\delta_{C,J(QC'\otimes M)}\circ Q(1_C\otimes v_{C',M})\circ Q(\alpha_{C,C',JM})\\
&=(1_{QC}\otimes(r_{QC'\otimes M}\circ Q(v_{C',M})))\circ\delta_{C,C'\otimes JM}\circ Q(\alpha_{C,C',JM})\\
&=(1_{QC}\otimes((1_{QC'}\otimes r_M)\circ\delta_{C',JM}))\circ\delta_{C,C'\otimes JM}\circ Q(\alpha_{C,C',JM}).
\end{aligned}$$
The final line applies Step 2 to $v_{C',M}$. Every displayed morphism has source $Q((C\otimes C')\otimes JM)$ and final target $T$.

source.place: Tags 0FFK and 0FFL; elementary tensorator naturality and substitution of Step 2 twice.

proof.text:
The inverse form of the strong monoidal associativity axiom, at $C,C',JM$, is
$$(1_{QC}\otimes\delta_{C',JM})\circ\delta_{C,C'\otimes JM}\circ Q(\alpha_{C,C',JM})
=\alpha_{QC,QC',QJM}\circ(\delta_{C,C'}\otimes1_{QJM})\circ\delta_{C\otimes C',JM}.$$
Postcompose this equation with $1_{QC}\otimes(1_{QC'}\otimes r_M)$. The left side becomes the last line of Step 6; naturality of $\alpha$ makes the right side equal $E$ of Step 5. Hence $r_T\circ Q(L)=r_T\circ Q(R)$. Step 3, with source $(C\otimes C')\otimes JM$, gives $L=R$. This proves the required associativity for the originally specified $v$.

source.place: Tags 0FFK, 0FFL and 0037; inverse monoidal associativity axiom, associator naturality and the proved equality test.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-N7-1bb441fa3 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item's seven steps in full and checked each identity. Step 2's symmetry and normalization calculation is correct. Step 3's equality test does not assume Q is faithful: it works for maps out of 1⊗JM and (C⊗C')⊗JM because v is already invertible. Step 4's unit law is correct, using the inverted strong-monoidal left-unit axiom and naturality of λ. Steps 5–7 are correct: the inverted associativity axiom, postcomposed with 1⊗(1⊗r_M), gives E by naturality of α. Sources checked: Stacks 0037/0FFK/0FFL; 0GL1 (sites-cohomology.tex:4578) and 0E8I (sites-modules.tex:4051); blueprint main-20261015 sk-prop-cohsm (G13), the projection-formula arrow. No SGA is cited. The statement is identical to live, the live item is still unsplit, and there is no re-split note. There are no new nodes. The three cited statements say what the steps take from them. Edge cases tested: J=Q=Id; a non-faithful Q (pr1 from Vect×Vect, J(M)=(M,0)), where both laws hold; and a scaled γ, which breaks the normalization. One C1 fault: invertibility of the unit u, used as r=u^{-1} in every step, was not cited.
